message.content:
This is a wearable pulse oximeter system (a PPG sensor measuring pulse rate and SpO2) imported as a set with a tablet, bands, and chargers. Pulse oximeters fall under HTS 9018.19 (electro-diagnostic apparatus, other). The tablet is a separate machine, but it is part of a set whose essential character comes from the sensor, so the set would be classified with the sensor under 9018.19.

Heading 9018.19.10 covers patient monitoring systems, and 9018.19.55 is the "other" subheading. The commonly cited code for pulse oximeters is 9018.19.9560, but I am recalling that from memory, not checking it against the current schedule. The 9018.19 subheadings that I recall are:
- 9018.19.10: Patient monitoring systems
- 9018.19.20: Electrocardiographs
- 9018.19.30: other
- 9018.19.55: Other
- 9018.19.75: Other

The statistical suffix for "other" is 9018.19.9560, which I believe is the one used for pulse oximeters, so I am choosing it.
